# Deprecated Font Fixtures

Fonts in this directory belong to the original broad, unoptimized fixture
corpus. Existing explicit parity cases may continue to reference them while
the compact custom corpus replaces their remaining unique coverage.

Do not add new cases against these fonts. Add focused glyphs and font features
to `../fonts/` or `../input/fonts/` instead. Once no explicit input references a
deprecated font, that font can be removed.
